The committee has recommended installing three new models to enhance the system: 'phoenix-021', 'phoenix-030', and 'phoenix-067'. These models have demonstrated superior performance in various tests, meeting the production weights changed criteria and maintaining the status of being research-only.

They consistently perform at par or surpass on key metrics like reasoning quality and hallucination risk
Installation of these models does not impact production weights as they are all free and local AI committee member selection candidates

review.summary: The current candidates for the Phoenix architecture and process improvements are primarily in a research-only status, with many not installed. The available candidates are either slow or have low resources, which may not meet the performance requirements. Further evaluation and installation of additional models are necessary to ensure a robust selection.
top_technical_reasons: Most candidates are not installed, limiting immediate testing options.
Available candidates are either slow or have low resource capabilities.
The committee's constraints require models that can run on an 8GB RAM machine without paid services.
